content.text:
pieces = text.split('/')
    if len(pieces) != 2:
        raise Fatal('%s %r needs an explicit CIDR slash' % (label, text))
    length_text = pieces[1]
    if length_text == '56':
        length = 56
    elif length_text == '64':
        length = 64
    else:
        raise Fatal('%s %r must use /56 or /64' % (label, text))
    value = ipv6_value(pieces[0])
    if value is None:
        raise Fatal('%s %r is not an IPv6 address inside 2001:db8::/32'
                    % (label, text))
    mask = ((1 << length) - 1) << (128 - length)
    if value & ~mask:
        raise Fatal('%s %r has host bits set' % (label, text))
    return value, length


def validate_manifest(document):
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise Fatal('manifest must be a JSON object')
    if document.keys() != TOP_KEYS:
        raise Fatal('manifest must have exactly the keys %s' % sorted(TOP_KEYS))
    if not is_int(document['version']) or document['version'] != 1:
        raise Fatal('version must be integer 1')
    seed = int_in_range(document['seed'], 0, (1 << 64) - 1, 'seed')
    low_count = int_in_range(document['low_count'], 1, 32, 'low_count')
    attempts = int_in_range(document['attempts'], 1, 3, 'attempts')
    spacing_ms = int_in_range(document['spacing_ms'], 1, 1000, 'spacing_ms')
    timeout_ms = int_in_range(document['timeout_ms'], 1, 1000000, 'timeout_ms')
    raw_windows = document['windows']
    if not isinstance(raw_windows, list):
        raise Fatal('windows must be an array')
    if len(raw_windows) > 8:
        raise Fatal('windows must hold at most 8 entries')

    model = Model()
    model.seed = seed
    model.low_count = low_count
    model.attempts = attempts
    model.spacing_ms = spacing_ms
    model.timeout_ms = timeout_ms
    model.windows = []
    model.segments = []

    window_ids = set()
    total_selected = 0
    for raw_window in raw_windows:
        if not isinstance(raw_window, dict):
            raise Fatal('each window must be an object')
        if raw_window.keys() != WINDOW_KEYS:
            raise Fatal('window must have exactly the keys %s'
                        % sorted(WINDOW_KEYS))
        window_id = check_id(raw_window['id'], 'window id')
        if window_id in window_ids:
            raise Fatal('duplicate window id %r' % window_id)
        window_ids.add(window_id)
        start_ms = int_in_range(raw_window['start_ms'], 0, 10 ** 12, 'start_ms')
        raw_scopes = raw_window['scopes']
